column1: # What the port's C for NTSC-U (hand.tsv's rows) does otherwise than the US code on purpose, for
# port/tools/versionmap/xcheck.py (README.md, "Checking the hand C against the US code"). A row of
# this table that matches nothing any more fails the check too: drop it with the change that ends it.

column4: the sphere test is the static helper FUN_001fa728 is made of: the alpha needs the test's far value, which retail keeps in a VU0 register across its call
the view's clip constants (D_0018CF80) the shared sphere test reads, which retail reads inside FUN_001fa728
the port's guard: a manipulator that cannot be made traps, where retail goes on and dereferences it
the four height predicates are compared with the table's pointer to call each by its own prototype (the host passes integers and floats in registers of their own)
retail repeats FUN_001fa480's quaternion rows in line; the C calls it for them

open: carried from PAL's level_nanotech_glow.c, which draws the sphere, halo and sheen through the port's quad drawer with the GS registers in each quad; the US routine sets them with vu1_add_g_sregister (FUN_00233980) and FUN_001f76a0 and draws the sphere strips with FUN_L00_001fde98
16-byte copies, which retail makes with lq and sq
returns where the retail copy traps on a bit that is already clear (said at the function)
the rotation rows are the VU0 microprogram's (vcallms) in retail; the C calls the routine that runs the same program
the port draws each block's strip with the strip drawer (as rac1-pal does); retail builds the VU1 packet in place
the strip drawer's texture coordinates, past the table's header the VU1 packet points at
the VU1 packet retail builds: its GIF header copied from 0x001C4620 and the texture table 0x001CB9C0 by reference
sine and cosine are VU0 microprograms in line in retail (vcallms 0xC80, 0xC90); the C calls FastSin and FastCos
retail reads the tables for a text id that only decides whether the row is drawn, and every way gives one (it always draws 0x5234); the C's same reads are dead and Clang drops them
